subject: Information Theory
title: Sexual Selection and Information
description: One-minute skill: Sexual Selection and Information.

hook.text: A peacock's tail screams 'I survived despite this handicap.' It's an honest signal—too costly to fake.

buildup.text: Zahavi's handicap principle: costly signals reliably indicate quality because only fit individuals can afford them.

discovery.text: In information theory terms, the cost ensures signal honesty. Cheap signals would be flooded with noise from fakers.

twist.text: Cheaters do exist—some species fake signals—but sustained cheating collapses the signal's value for everyone.

climax.text: Sexual selection is a communication system. Honest signaling requires that faking be costlier than being genuine.

punchline.text: Costly signals are honest signals. The price ensures the truth.

quiz.question: Why do costly signals indicate quality?
options: Only fit individuals can afford the cost, ensuring honesty
